tools.name: get_firm_info
tools.description: What the Employment Lawyers Group handles, who it represents, fees, and the address, phone and contact page for one office.

tools.name: list_offices
tools.description: Every office of the firm with its city, county, address, phone and website. Use it to pick the office nearest the person.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Keyword search over the firm's published pages (employment-law topics, attorney profiles, case results). Returns title, summary, URL and a Markdown URL for each match.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Opens the firm's consultation request form for one office. Used by hosts that show a Get Quote button; pass the office business_id from the business feed (its site host). The form itself files the request with the person's consent.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: File a free, confidential consultation request with the firm on behalf of a person who has agreed to it. Goes through the same intake as the website contact form; the firm calls or emails back. Not for marketing or solicitation.
